# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 1 token; Text — 1 token; Fills and status backgrounds — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 10 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 8 tokens; Radius — 1 token; Shadow — 2 tokens; Timing — 7 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the day theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ground, #fbf4f7);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="night" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the night column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--ground, #1f1619);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #fbf4f7;
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | day | night | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ground` | #fbf4f7 | #1f1619 | 일러스트가 없는 화면의 바탕(휴대폰 등). 아주 옅은 벚꽃 핑크. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css

/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="night" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the night column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--panel, rgba(46, 32, 36, 0.82));
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: rgba(255, 249, 252, 0.86);
```

| `--muted` | #7d6663 | #d9c6c8 | 뒷줄에서 꼭 읽지 않아도 되는 보조 정보만: 지문, 스테이지 번호, 인원. 판 위 5.1:1. |
| `--line` | rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) | rgba(251, 241, 242, 0.16) | 유리 판의 2px 테두리. 낮에는 흰 빛 테두리로 판 가장자리를 세워요. |

| `--alert` | #b0343f | #ff9a9f | 타이머 5초 이하, 입력 오류, 전송 실패. 장미 쪽 빨강. |
| `--ok` | #4f7a5f | #9fcfae | 투표 접수 완료 점. 채도 낮은 세이지. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 900 112px/1.15 'Wanted Sans', Pretendard, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Malgun Gothic', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.035em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-stage-title); letter-spacing: -0.035em;
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Font files

Fonts: `tokens.css` loads each font from its file, by path.

- **Design canvas:** copy `fonts/WantedSans-Medium.woff2`, `fonts/WantedSans-SemiBold.woff2`, `fonts/WantedSans-Bold.woff2`, `fonts/WantedSans-ExtraBold.woff2` and `fonts/WantedSans-Black.woff2` to the same paths under the canvas’s `project/ds/<folder>/` (`<folder>` is the folder you install this system under; `fonts/WantedSans-Medium.woff2` lands on `project/ds/<folder>/fonts/WantedSans-Medium.woff2`), in the same call that installs this system; the copy of `tokens.css` that each artboard links loads them from there. If the install’s reply leaves a font out, bring that font in as for any other page.
- **Slides deck:** for each family you use in the deck (`faces` holds at most the number of typefaces Slides’ `deck-files.md` gives), install its file with the system and name the path it lands on as that family’s `src` in `project/deck.json` `faces`, under the key in the Slides column. A deck takes a font as a file only under the rule in Slides’ `fonts.md` (no space or leading underscore in its path, for two): any other font, or one kept by id, is uploaded as `fonts.md` says.
- **Any other page:** one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`), upload it as an asset (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) and declare it with an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule.

`tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that links it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `faces` key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Wanted Sans | `fonts/WantedSans-Medium.woff2` (weight 500) | `read fonts/WantedSans-Medium.woff2` | `var(--font-line)` | `wanted-sans` |

Every face: `fonts/WantedSans-Medium.woff2` (Wanted Sans, 500), `fonts/WantedSans-SemiBold.woff2` (Wanted Sans, 600), `fonts/WantedSans-Bold.woff2` (Wanted Sans, 700), `fonts/WantedSans-ExtraBold.woff2` (Wanted Sans, 800), `fonts/WantedSans-Black.woff2` (Wanted Sans, 900).

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--s-1);
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--s-1` | 4px | 아이콘과 글자. |
| `--s-2` | 8px | 촘촘한 묶음. |
| `--s-3` | 12px | 휴대폰 버튼 사이. |
| `--s-4` | 16px | 휴대폰 화면 여백. |
| `--s-5` | 24px | 휴대폰 카드 안쪽, 무대 카드 사이. |
| `--s-6` | 32px | 무대 판 안쪽 세로 여백. |
| `--s-7` | 48px | 무대 판 안쪽 가로 여백. |
| `--s-8` | 64px | 무대 화면 가장자리 여백 (프로젝터 잘림 방지). |

## Radius

모서리는 하나뿐이에요. 무대(1080p 기준)와 휴대폰에서 똑같이 24px로 보여요. 얼굴 사진과 타이머 링처럼 원 자체가 모양인 것만 원으로 둬요.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--r-ui: 24px) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--r-ui), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--r-ui` | 24px | 모든 판, 선택지 카드, 버튼, 입력칸, 이름 탭, 칩, 번호 배지, 말풍선. 무대에서는 24 × --u. |
